headline_marked: AI creates [[16 new viruses]] different from any natural ones
headline: AI creates 16 new viruses different from any natural ones
summary: Scientists from Stanford University and the Arc Institute used an AI tool called 'Evo' to design and synthesize functional viral genomes.
details: Scientists have used an artificial intelligence program to create new viral genomes that are distinct from any known natural viruses. These synthetic viruses are capable of attacking specific host cells.

The research, recently published in the Science journal, utilized an AI tool named 'Evo'. The tool was trained on genetic sequences, similar to how Large Language Models like ChatGPT are trained on vast amounts of text data.
Researchers from Stanford University and the Arc Institute used Evo to generate thousands of genome combinations within a specific framework.
Out of these thousands of AI-generated genomes, the scientists synthesized and tested approximately 300 viruses in a laboratory setting.
The results showed that 16 of these synthetic viruses were functional and 'alive', marking a significant leap in genetic engineering.
While this advancement offers new possibilities for medical research and treatment, it has sparked intense concerns regarding the potential for misuse of such technology.

headline: Content creator arrested for raping 15-year-old girl in Netrokona
summary: Ripon Mia allegedly lured the victim with promises of social media fame before the assault. The arrest followed a viral video of a failed village arbitration attempt.
details: A content creator named Ripon Mia was arrested by a Rab team in the Mohisharon Achintapur area of Gouripur early yesterday morning.
The victim, a 15-year-old girl, was allegedly raped by Ripon, who was her neighbor. He reportedly lured her to the bank of the Mogra river on July 30 by promising to make her 'viral' on social media.
The victim's father filed a case under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000, on August 5.

According to Netrokona Sadar Model Police Station OC Abul Khayer, local influential people initially tried to settle the matter through a village arbitration (salish), انجام which reportedly fined the accused Tk 5 lakh.
The police intervened and encouraged the family to file a formal case after a video of the arbitration process circulated on social media.
Ripon Mia had been absconding since the case was filed until his arrest by Rab-14 Mymensingh Battalion.
caption:
Promised her social media fame, then raped her. A content creator is now behind bars.

A content creator named Ripon Mia was arrested by a Rab team in the Mohisharon Achintapur area of Gouripur early yesterday morning.

The victim, a 15-year-old girl, was allegedly raped by Ripon, who was her neighbor. He reportedly lured her to the bank of the Mogra river on July 30 by promising to make her 'viral' on social media.

The victim's father filed a case under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000, on August 5.

According to Netrokona Sadar Model Police Station OC Abul Khayer, local influential people initially tried to settle the matter through a village arbitration (salish), انجام which reportedly fined the accused Tk 5 lakh.

The police intervened and encouraged the family to file a formal case after a video of the arbitration process circulated on social media.

Ripon Mia had been absconding since the case was filed until his arrest by Rab-14 Mymensingh Battalion.
